evals.prompt: Fix open review threads on PR #42 for oauth-login.
evals.expected_output: Threads addressed with evidence; uses provider scripts via shims.
assertions: Agent loads ws-fix-pr
Uses fetch_threads/resolve_thread via documented script paths
Does not claim threads resolved without checking remote state

evals.expected_output: Cooperative fix flow per skill; no blind auto-resolve without reading threads.
assertions: Agent reads thread content before resolving
Uses provider-appropriate SCM from config
Uses path tokens ({skillsRoot}, {sharedDir}, {plansDir}) instead of hardcoded consumer paths

evals.prompt: A review thread on validate-evals.cjs says the gate claims schema validation but never reads the schema, and notes the same pattern in a copied helper.
evals.expected_output: Defect class named; proactive discovery; both occurrences fixed or skipped with path+reason before resolve.
assertions: Agent names a defect class, not only the anchored file:line
Agent runs proactive discovery (code grep and context) before resolving the thread
Agent does not close the thread while named sibling paths remain unfixed without an exemption

evals.prompt: A review thread on src/auth/token.cjs flags missing null checks; grep finds the same unchecked access in src/auth/refresh.cjs (not named in the thread).
evals.expected_output: Second same-class path fixed or explicitly skipped with path+reason; proactive report fields recorded before resolve.
assertions: Agent fixes refresh.cjs or records proactiveSkipped with path and reason
Agent records defectClass and proactiveFixed or proactiveSkipped on plan-gate or resolution
Agent does not resolve after fixing only token.cjs when refresh.cjs remains unfixed without a skip

evals.prompt: A review thread flags a small typo in one helper; proactive grep finds the same typo class in a large legacy module that would require a cross-package refactor.
evals.expected_output: Small hit fixed; large hit recorded under proactiveSkipped with path+reason; class not marked fully cleared.
assertions: Agent applies the size gate: fixes the local hit and skips the large refactor with an explicit reason
Agent lists the skipped path under proactiveSkipped, not silent omission
Agent does not claim the defect class is fully cleared when a same-class hit was skipped

evals.prompt: Fix PR threads with enableMemoryFiles true but no MEMORY.md, and enableSpecMemoIntegration false.
evals.expected_output: Fix-pr proceeds; memory-files consult-skipped recorded in sourcesConsulted; not a fatal error.
assertions: Agent does not abort fix-pr because MEMORY.md is missing
Agent records memory-files consult-skipped (or memory consult-skipped) in sourcesConsulted
Agent still runs code and context proactive discovery before resolve

evals.prompt: A code-reviewer CI thread scored 8 flags a missing null check that we just shipped; fix it and finish the pass (dual memory backends enabled).
evals.expected_output: Surgical fix plus update-memory trap (local and/or vault) so the next round does not repeat the mistake; Learning: N/A is forbidden for this accepted defect.
assertions: Agent persists via update-memory (memory/YYYY-MM-DD-fix-pr-*.md and/or vault upsert) or cites an existing Medium+ read-memory hit after fixing the accepted reviewer/CI defect
Agent compiles MEMORY after a local write when enableMemoryFiles is true
Agent does not use Learning: N/A for an accepted score 6-10 reviewer/CI defect

evals.prompt: Fix three active threads on PR #42 with separate reviewer and execution model preferences.
evals.expected_output: One batch-wide fixPrPlan writes the complete gate before one fixPrExec edits; numeric Step 9 remains outer-only.
assertions: Agent performs sync and dirty-worktree preflight before fixPrPlan
fixPrPlan writes only plan-gate.md with batchId, prId, headSha, activeThreadIds, scores, proposed actions, proactive placeholders, and amendments
No product edit, commit, push, resolve-thread, or Step 9 finish occurs in fixPrPlan
Agent runs one fixPrPlan and one fixPrExec for the three-thread batch, not one pair per thread

evals.prompt: During fixPrExec, refreshed thread evidence changes the approved action for thread 17.
evals.expected_output: Execution validates gate identity and HEAD, then appends a structured amendment before any deviating edit.
assertions: Agent re-plans instead of editing when batchId, PR, thread batch, or headSha is stale
Agent appends timestamp, threadId, newFact, previousAction, revisedAction, rationale, and evidence source before the revised edit
Agent still completes COOPERATIVE_FIX proactive discovery and verification before resolve or push
